uncertainty_and_review_rules: No exact resource counters, opcode counts, requested-System values, stack bytes or source locations are adopted from a guess. Preserve raw measured values later without blessing them as passing evidence.

Expected statuses, test names/counts, callback ordering and native-failure booleans are source-derived assertions for review, not observed current behavior. Any failure requires diagnosis, not automatic expectation rewriting. JS throw diagnostics use modern.safe_error's constant ThrownValue data, never the thrown object's message label.

The unhandled-rejection harness handler passes an own undefined stack for primitive reasons with no stack. Cases 07 and 15 require actual OptionalUtf16 Undefined under root's reviewed contract correction, never normalization to Null or missing-descriptor acceptance.
Terminal/resource/observer faults, infrastructure, missing completion and failed cleanup cannot be accepted as one of the intended semantic outcomes merely because the control is negative.

Full-harness timeout/cleanup stall variants, malformed callback/UTF16/caps/GC/privacy and wire faults also need focused native/shared-ledger tests; they are not an excuse to expand this fixed first-control inventory after execution.
